name: New Issue
overview: This form allows you to report a new issue, such as quality issues, missing linens, or heavy soilage. It dynamically branches depending on whether the source is a Customer or a Laundry vendor.
wrapUp: Great! We have walked through reporting an issue for both Customer and Laundry branches, seeing how fields dynamically show up.

fields.label: Issue Date
fields.explanation: Select the date the issue was recorded.

fields.label: Source Type
fields.explanation: Source Type decides who the issue is about – a Customer hotel or a Laundry vendor.

explain.full: Source Type decides who the issue is about – a Customer hotel or a Laundry vendor. This controls what appears in Source Name and Trigger Entity.

fields.label: Source Name
fields.explanation: Select the specific Customer or Laundry Vendor.

explain.full: Search and select the customer hotel or laundry vendor related to this issue.

delta.CUSTOMER: Now we select the customer hotel. Let's select Arama Suites.
delta.LAUNDRY: Now we select the laundry vendor. Let's select LinenCare Services.

explain.full: Select the entity that triggered this issue – either an Order or a Wash Fulfillment.

delta.CUSTOMER: Notice that Trigger Entity automatically changed to ORDER for the Customer.
delta.LAUNDRY: Notice that Trigger Entity automatically changed to WASH_FULFILLMENT for the Laundry.

fields.label: Order Date
fields.explanation: Select the order date to filter orders.

explain.full: Select the Order Date. This will automatically load the customer's orders for that day.

fields.label: Orders
fields.emptyMessage: No orders found for this selection. You can still continue without linking one.
fields.explanation: Link a specific order to this issue if applicable.

explain.full: Select the Wash Date to link this issue with laundry processing on that date.

fields.label: Issue Type
fields.explanation: Select the category of the issue, like missing items or quality defects.

fields.label: Status
fields.explanation: Choose the initial status of the issue.

fields.label: Product
fields.explanation: Optionally select the product affected by the issue.

fields.label: Quantity
fields.explanation: Enter the quantity of items affected.
